pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to losing positions; multi-ticket entries (such as tickets 1707578236 and 1707578239) are banned unless the initial entry has already secured a 1R trailing stop-loss.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated 3-tick volume delta confirmation and zero high-impact macroeconomic news in the preceding/succeeding 15-minute window before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop activation once floating profit hits +$6.00 to lock in the asymmetric target range of $15-$30+.
